fields.description: Prefix used to auto-generate the unique inspection number for each record.
The specific customer-owned asset (e.g. fire extinguisher or unit) being inspected during this visit.
fields.label: Installed Equipment

fields.description: The field service job this inspection was carried out under.
fields.label: Service Job

fields.description: The scheduled on-site visit during which the technician performed the inspection.
fields.label: Service Visit

fields.description: The checklist template whose items define the checks the technician must complete.
fields.label: Inspection Template

fields.description: Version number of the template captured at inspection time so results stay tied to the exact checklist used.
fields.label: Template Revision

fields.description: The field technician who physically performed and signed off the inspection.
fields.label: Technician

fields.description: The customer who owns the inspected equipment, copied from the service job.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: The operating company responsible for delivering this service.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: The physical site or location where the equipment is installed and was inspected.
fields.label: Customer Site

fields.description: Progress state of the inspection: In Progress, Completed, or Cancelled.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Date and time the technician began the inspection on site.
fields.label: Started On

fields.description: Date and time the technician finished and submitted the inspection.
fields.label: Completed On

fields.description: Aggregate outcome derived from the individual checklist results, indicating whether the equipment passed or needs action.
fields.label: Overall Result
fields.options:
Pending
Pass
Fail
Needs Refill
Needs Repair
Needs Replacement
Not Accessible
Skipped

fields.description: System-suggested next step (e.g. refill, repair, or replace) based on failed checklist items.
fields.label: Corrective Action Hint

fields.description: Line-by-line inspection findings, one row per checklist item with its measured value and verdict.
fields.label: Results

fields.description: Free-text observations or remarks the technician recorded during the inspection.
fields.label: Notes
